_about: Curated facts about the flood events that the extracted files do not carry (country, admin area, cause). Read by `python -m forecaster.hazards import flood`; events missing here are still imported, with these fields null. Causes paraphrase the event READMEs (title, reported period and 'Things to know'); rainDriven=false marks events the rainfall/soil-moisture model does not apply to.

01_mozambique_limpopo.cause: Lower Limpopo river flood; much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box

02_china_guangxi.cause: Typhoon Maysak heavy rain (4-6 Jul) and the Liulan reservoir breach (6 Jul)

03_pakistan_punjab.cause: Ravi / Chenab monsoon river floods; much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box

04_usa_indiana.cause: Heavy rain from 11 Aug; White River above flood stage 12-18 Aug

05_nepal_trishuli.cause: Langtang glacier/rock collapse on 26 Aug and a debris flood down the Trishuli, not rain

06_india_bihar_patna.cause: Ganga river flood (above the danger mark at Patna); much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box

07_india_bihar_bhagalpur.cause: Ganga river flood (above the danger mark at Bhagalpur); much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box

08_usa_wabash.cause: Wabash River above flood stage (record at Linn Grove)

10_bangladesh_chattogram.cause: Floods on the Sangu and Dolu rivers
